system.intro: Remote access, the device location, and a factory reset. Some of these need a companion plugin on the device. The language is on the Voice and language page, and the network status on the Network page.
system.needsPlugin: This needs the ovos-PHAL-plugin-system plugin, which is not installed or not answering.
system.ssh.title: SSH
system.ssh.hint: SSH lets you log into the device over the network with a terminal. Only turn it on if you trust this network.
system.ssh.unavailable: The system plugin did not answer. SSH cannot be checked or changed here.
system.ssh.on: SSH is on. The device accepts remote terminal logins.
system.ssh.confirmOn: Turn SSH on? The device will accept remote terminal logins on this network.
system.ssh.confirmOff: Turn SSH off? You will not be able to log in remotely until you turn it back on.
system.location.hint: Looks up an approximate location from the device's public IP address, and saves it as the device location.
system.location.confirm: Look up an approximate location from this device's public IP address, and save it as the device location?
system.location.overridden: Location found, but your configuration sets a location of its own, which wins. Clear it on the Settings page to use the detected one.
system.location.ignored: Location found, but this device is configured to ignore the detected location. It will keep the location it already has.
system.factory.title: Factory reset
system.factory.warn: This erases all settings, skills, and personal data on the device and returns it to its factory defaults. This cannot be undone.
system.factory.typePrompt: This erases all settings and data on the device and cannot be undone. Type RESET to continue:
system.factory.cancelled: Factory reset cancelled — the text did not match.
system.factory.confirm: Are you sure? The device will erase everything and restart.
system.factory.sent: Sent. If the system plugin is installed, the device is wiping now and will restart.
